about: I'm an engineering graduate with a background in telecommunications and information technology, interested in software engineering, artificial intelligence, and data-driven solutions.
I'm curious about how technology works and enjoy exploring different fields, learning new things, and solving real-world problems.

aboutDetails.title: Background
aboutDetails.text: My engineering education provided me with a multidisciplinary foundation spanning communication technologies, networked systems, signal processing, software development, and data-driven computing. It exposed me to different aspects of technology, from understanding how information is transmitted and processed to developing software, working with data, and exploring intelligent solutions.

aboutDetails.title: Areas of Interest
aboutDetails.text: I'm drawn to the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, and data, particularly how they can be combined to solve real-world problems. I enjoy experimenting with AI models, exploring prompting techniques, and finding creative ways to use technology. I'm equally interested in turning ideas into functional applications and exploring how different technologies can work together to create useful solutions.

aboutDetails.title: Featured Work
aboutDetails.text: My projects span software development, data analytics, machine learning, and AI, allowing me to explore different technologies and approaches to problem-solving. From data processing and predictive modeling to prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), I've applied what I've learned to develop practical solutions.

aboutDetails.title: Career Goals
aboutDetails.text: I'm looking to begin my professional journey where I can apply my knowledge, learn from experienced professionals, and contribute to meaningful projects. I'm eager to deepen my technical skills, explore new technologies, and grow into an engineer who can turn ideas and complex problems into practical solutions.
